Laboratory.cell: ETH Zurich; sample digestion and separation at Tokyo Institute of Technology
Laboratory.value: ETH Zurich; sample digestion and separation at Tokyo Institute of Technology

Coupled Technique(s).cell: Mg, K, Ca, Ti, Cr, Fe, Cu, Zn, Mo and Nd isotope data "all obtained from the same sample digestions and are therefore directly comparable"
Coupled Technique(s).value: Mg, K, Ca, Ti, Cr, Fe, Cu, Zn, Mo and Nd isotope data "all obtained from the same sample digestions and are therefore directly comparable"

Target Material.cell: Ryugu returned samples, carbonaceous chondrites, eucrites and terrestrial rock reference materials

value.member: eucrites and terrestrial rock reference materials

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Digestion aliquot — Ryugu "aliquots of <25 mg were analyzed with ~40 to 70 ng Zr"; Tagish Lake 30 mg, Tarda 90 mg, Ivuna 40 and 44 mg "from a larger homogenized powder (550 mg)"

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Homogenised powder — Ivuna aliquots taken "from a larger homogenized powder (550 mg)"

Digestion Acid(s).cell: Concentrated HF-HNO3, then a HNO3-HCl mixture, then a HNO3-H2O2 mixture; Ivuna high PT: concentrated HF-HNO3 for 3 days then concentrated HCl for 2 days

value.value: concentrated HF-HNO3 for 3 days then concentrated HCl for 2 days

Digestion Vessel Type.cell: Octagonal-body Savillex vials; Parr bomb (Ivuna PB, BCR-2, AGV-1); hotplate (BHVO-2)
Digestion Vessel Type.value: Octagonal-body Savillex vials; Parr bomb (Ivuna PB, BCR-2, AGV-1); hotplate (BHVO-2)

Digestion Step.cell: Main route 1: concentrated HF-HNO3 | 2: HNO3-HCl | 3: HNO3-H2O2. Ivuna high-PT route 1: concentrated HF-HNO3, 3 days | 2: concentrated HCl, 2 days.

value.member: Main route 1: concentrated HF-HNO3 | 2: HNO3-HCl | 3: HNO3-H2O2. Ivuna high-PT route 1: concentrated HF-HNO3

Digestion Temperature.cell: 180 °C (hotplate), 120 °C (HNO3-HCl), 220 °C (Savillex, Tagish Lake and Tarda), 170 °C (Parr bomb, Ivuna PB), 160 °C (Ivuna high PT)

Digestion Duration.cell: 3–7 days (hotplate), 12 h (HNO3-HCl), "about a week" (Tagish Lake and Tarda), 3 days + 2 days (Ivuna high PT)

Final Solution Matrix.cell: 0.5 M HNO3 - 0.005 M HF at 30 ppb Zr (also 17 and 60 ppb)

Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.cell: Ryugu <25 mg with ~40–70 ng Zr; 15 ng Zr consumed per 30 ppb analysis
Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.value: Ryugu <25 mg with ~40–70 ng Zr; 15 ng Zr consumed per 30 ppb analysis

Chromatographic Separation Applied.cell: Yes — four-step separation on anion exchange (AG 1-X8), DGA and LN resin; two-stage anion exchange for Ivuna; three-stage AG 1-X8 + LN for terrestrial samples

Isotope Dilution Spike.cell: N/A — no isotope dilution spike; mass bias handled by standard-sample bracketing or internal normalization

ICP-MS Type.cell: Multi-collector sector-field ICP-MS [all columns state "multi-collector inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"]
ICP-MS Type.value: Multi-collector sector-field ICP-MS [all columns state "multi-collector inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"]

Interface Cone Configuration.cell: "Normal skimmer and sampler cones were utilized"
Interface Cone Configuration.value: "Normal skimmer and sampler cones were utilized"

Faraday Cup Amplifier Resistor Values.cell: 10^11 Ω for 90Zr–96Zr and 95Mo; 10^12 Ω for 99Ru and 101Ru

Nebulizer Type.cell: PFA nebulizer with an Aridus II desolvating nebulizer system
Nebulizer Type.value: PFA nebulizer with an Aridus II desolvating nebulizer system

ICP Tuning.cell: "Tuning was performed to minimize interferences of 40Ar2 16O+ and 40Ar2 14N+ on 96Zr+ and 94Zr+ and with it the on-peak background corrections"
ICP Tuning.value: "Tuning was performed to minimize interferences of 40Ar2 16O+ and 40Ar2 14N+ on 96Zr+ and 94Zr+ and with it the on-peak background corrections"

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: ⁹⁰Zr, ⁹¹Zr, ⁹²Zr, ⁹⁴Zr, ⁹⁶Zr (Zr); ⁹⁵Mo, ⁹⁹Ru, ¹⁰¹Ru (interference monitors, no target species) — "Faraday cups with 10¹¹ Ω amplifiers were used to collect Zr masses 90Zr to 96Zr and 95Mo, whereas 10¹² Ω amplifiers were applied for the collection of 99Ru and 101Ru" (p.6)

Reported Variables and Units.cell: ε91Zr, ε92Zr and ε96Zr relative to NIST SRM 3169

value.member: ε92Zr and ε96Zr relative to NIST SRM 3169

Collector Configuration.cell: 90Zr–96Zr and 95Mo on 10^11 Ω cups; 99Ru and 101Ru on 10^12 Ω cups

Baseline Measurement Approach.cell: Both: "Electronic baselines were measured for 30 s prior to each analysis. An on-peak background correction was performed."
Baseline Measurement Approach.value: Both: "Electronic baselines were measured for 30 s prior to each analysis. An on-peak background correction was performed."

Analysis Sequence.cell: Standard sample bracketing against NIST SRM 3169; "The Zr standard material NIST SRM 3169 was analyzed in each session"
Analysis Sequence.value: Standard sample bracketing against NIST SRM 3169; "The Zr standard material NIST SRM 3169 was analyzed in each session"

Internal Standard Element.cell: N/A — mass bias corrected by standard-sample bracketing, internal normalization or a double spike rather than by an added internal standard element

Internal Standard Concentration.cell: N/A — no added internal standard element

Oxide Production Method and Threshold.cell: Argide and Ar-Ar-oxide interferences on 94Zr and 96Zr minimised by tuning; no numeric threshold stated
Oxide Production Method and Threshold.value: Argide and Ar-Ar-oxide interferences on 94Zr and 96Zr minimised by tuning; no numeric threshold stated

Mass Bias Correction Strategy.cell: Internal normalization to 94Zr/90Zr = 0.3381 using the exponential law; an initial Mo correction uses a mass bias relative to 91Zr/90Zr = 0.21798; results reported by standard sample bracketing to NIST SRM 3169
Mass Bias Correction Strategy.value: Internal normalization to 94Zr/90Zr = 0.3381 using the exponential law; an initial Mo correction uses a mass bias relative to 91Zr/90Zr = 0.21798; results reported by standard sample bracketing to NIST SRM 3169

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: "An on-peak background correction was performed"; background corrections averaged 0.3, 2 and 98 ppm for 91Zr/90Zr, 92Zr/90Zr and 96Zr/90Zr
Blank / Background Correction Method.value: "An on-peak background correction was performed"; background corrections averaged 0.3, 2 and 98 ppm for 91Zr/90Zr, 92Zr/90Zr and 96Zr/90Zr

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: Yes — Mo and Ru on Zr, plus Fe- and Cr-argides and Ar-Ar-oxides

Interference Correction Method.cell: Mo and Ru corrections calculated from the signals on mass 95, 99 and 101, with an initial Mo correction using a mass bias relative to 91Zr/90Zr = 0.21798

Uncertainty Level.cell: Both quoted: "external precision expressed as 2 standard deviations (2SD)" and 2SE per analysis
Uncertainty Level.value: Both quoted: "external precision expressed as 2 standard deviations (2SD)" and 2SE per analysis

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Rule: data outside the 2SD uncertainty are rejected as outliers; n stated per sample (n = 13–99 for terrestrial RMs; n = 17–38 for eucrites and Colony) — Table 1 note: 'An outlier rejection was carried out with rejection of data that falls outside the 2SD uncertainty'
Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.value: Rule: data outside the 2SD uncertainty are rejected as outliers; n stated per sample (n = 13–99 for terrestrial RMs; n = 17–38 for eucrites and Colony)

Combination Method.cell: all: average of the individual measurements of each sample — Fig. 1: 'the average of each sample with the corresponding uncertainty given as the 2 sd calculated from the individual sample measurements'

value.value: average of the individual measurements of each sample

Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.cell: Each session — "The Zr standard material NIST SRM 3169 was analyzed in each session"

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: BHVO-2, BCR-2, AGV-1, SCo-1; eucrites Bouvante and Bereba; CO chondrite Colony

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical P.cell: Terrestrial RMs measured over 10 months (n = 13–99) give average 2SD of 0.3, 0.2 and 1.0 for ε91Zr, ε92Zr and ε96Zr; "The external precision estimated from the geological sample measurements integrates the uncertainty introduced by the chemical separation procedure and mass spectrometry"

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: Terrestrial and meteorite reference materials measured repeatedly to verify data quality; doping tests with Ti, V, Cr, Mo, Hf and W showed "the observed trace levels have no effect on the accuracy of the Zr isotope data"
